title: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) / Master of Philosophy (MPhil) in Computing
institution: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU), Department of Computing
field: Computing (AI and big data, cyber security, networking and mobile computing)
about: PolyU Department of Computing PhD/MPhil, September 2027 entry, with research areas including AI and big data computing. Applications close 31 May 2027; Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme candidates must apply by 1 December 2026.
requirements: HKPFS applicants must first apply to the Research Grants Council (1 September to 1 December 2026), then submit the full PolyU application by 1 December 2026, 23:59 HKT
Non-local applicants should apply 4 months before the start of the semester
